messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "most other water pills"
set: ["most other water pills", "diet pills", "using other water pills has not worked well enough to treat this swelling", "longer than most other antidepressants", "birth control pills", "water", "water pill", "another water pill", "Water for injection", "not what most people pay", "water and electrolyte depletion", "20mg per day for most conditions", "especially diuretic or water pill", "FDA's most serious type of warning", "other medications", "other drugs"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
